logic: where user_id = session user; unread first.

relativeTime() (R-M08); kind vocabulary (R-M07).

spec.purpose: KPIs across locations: revenue, occupancy, arrivals, grooming, pending vaccines, feedback.
logic: sum totals by location and period

Completion = training_completions rows of the signed-in employee.
readingMinutes = words/180 + figures + directives.

spec.name: Staff PIN login
spec.purpose: Fast staff sign-in with a 4-6 digit PIN; lands on the role home and pins the location for front desk / groomer.
logic: findByPin(pin, holders): hash the PIN (FNV-1a mock) and match employees.pin_hash merged with demo holders.
On success switchUser(userId) and navigate to ROLE_HOME[role]; the LocationProvider pins location-scoped roles.
Wrong PIN clears the pad and shows an error; the real backend rate-limits.

spec.name: Profile hub
spec.purpose: The Settings tab of the customer app: photo, name and email, then the account menu (edit profile, pets, payment methods, notifications, chat, app settings, help, rate, about, log out).
logic: useCustomerAccount resolves the customer behind the user; staff previewing falls back to the demo customer.
Unread notification and chat counts as badges.
Photo picker stores a data URL in users.avatar_url (mock upload, 1.5 MB cap).
Log out = signOut() then /auth/sign-in.

spec.name: Edit profile
spec.purpose: Edit contact details and address; email and password change through separate confirmation flows.
layout: Sign-in (email read-only + Change email modal; password disabled + Change password link)
logic: Required: first, last, mobile; phone and ZIP format checks.
Save updates customers and mirrors name / phone to users.
Change email asks for the new address and the current password (mock), writes audit_log email.change.

spec.name: App settings
spec.purpose: Device and account settings: language, dark mode, colour theme, notification preferences, change password, payment methods, delete account.
layout: Appearance (language row, dark mode toggle, colour theme segmented)
Account (notifications, password, payment methods, delete account)
logic: Dark mode and brand write through ThemeProvider (localStorage petrock.theme).
Language row shows the current language and opens C-73.

spec.name: Language
spec.purpose: Pick the app language (English, Español) and save it on the device and on the account.
logic: Save is disabled until the choice differs; on save setLang() + users.preferred_language.
Every module string has en / es entries; missing es falls back to en.

spec.name: Payment methods
spec.purpose: Saved cards for faster deposits: list, add (tokenised), make default, remove; cash at the location stays available.
layout: Add card modal (name, number, expiry, CVC, ZIP, default)
logic: Brand detected from the number prefix, Luhn check, expiry MM/YY not in the past, 3-4 digit CVC, 5-digit ZIP.
Only brand, last4, expiry, holder and a provider token are stored (R-M22).
One default per customer; removing the default promotes the next card; removed cards keep status removed for invoices.

spec.name: Notification preferences
spec.purpose: Choose per category (bookings, vaccines, chat, payments, offers) which channels (push, email, SMS) reach you.
layout: Matrix card (category rows x channel toggles)
logic: Missing rows are created with defaults on first open (offers off, bookings on everywhere).
Each toggle saves immediately.

spec.name: Delete account
spec.purpose: App-store required flow: explain the 30-day grace period, block on active bookings, collect a reason, require typing DELETE, then schedule the deletion and sign out.
logic: Blocked while any booking is requested / pending_vaccines / confirmed / checked_in.
Insert account_deletion_requests (requested, scheduled_for = today + 30) and audit_log account.delete_requested; signOut(); go to sign-in.
A pending request can be cancelled from the same screen.

spec.name: Help & support
spec.purpose: Get help: chat with the Front Desk, call a location, browse the FAQ by topic, send a support request and see past requests with staff replies.
layout: Contact us (chat, call per location, website)
logic: Support request needs a topic and 10+ characters; stored with the home location for the desk.
Phone rows use tel: links (R-M11 replaces voice / video calls).

spec.name: About & legal
spec.purpose: App version, legal documents, our locations with today's hours, rate and delete links, company footer.
logic: Version from package.json (__APP_VERSION__).
Hours for today from locations.hours; address opens Maps.

spec.name: Legal document
spec.purpose: Reads a published legal document (privacy policy, terms of service, licences) with version and effective date.
logic: Looked up by slug; unpublished or unknown slug shows an EmptyState.

spec.name: Notification centre
spec.purpose: All in-app notifications grouped by day with an unread filter and mark-all-read; the Inbox tab shows the Front Desk threads.
logic: Tap marks read and follows notifications.link; dismiss removes the row.
Relative times per R-M08; groups Today / Yesterday / weekday / date.

spec.name: Inbox
spec.purpose: The Chat tab: one Front Desk conversation per location with preview, time and unread count; locations without a thread offer to start one.
logic: Starting a thread inserts conversations + a system "Session start" message.
Preview shows "You:" when the last message is the customer's.

spec.name: Front Desk chat
spec.purpose: Message the Front Desk of one location: day markers, bubbles with read receipts, photo attachments, quick replies, typing indicator and a demo staff reply.
logic: Opening marks staff messages read and zeroes unread_customer (R-M24).
Send inserts the message, updates the conversation preview and unread_staff; a mock staff reply follows in ~3 s and marks the customer's messages Seen.
Bubbles within 5 minutes from the same sender are grouped; own messages right in primary (R-M25).
Images: jpg / png / webp up to 2 MB as data URLs (R-M28).

spec.name: Rate the app
spec.purpose: Leave a star rating, tags and a comment; the owner moderates it before it appears on the website.
logic: Insert reviews (status pending, rating 1-5, tags).
Store review prompt is a placeholder until Capacitor.
integrations: App Store / Play review sheet (Capacitor) later

spec.name: Change password
spec.purpose: Change the account password with a strength meter and rule checklist; other devices are signed out.
layout: Card (current, forgot link, new + strength, repeat)
logic: New password needs score >= 2 (8+ chars, letter + number), must differ from current and match the repeat.
Mock check; writes audit_log password.change.

Open now = current time inside locations.hours for today.

spec.name: Website: Hotel

Room count = sum of penthouse + suite capacities across locations.

Add-on "from" when starting_at.
integrations: Squarespace (current petrockhotel.com, to be replaced by these pages)

isOpenNow() from locations.hours and the browser clock.

spec.name: Reports overview
spec.purpose: KPIs for 7 / 30 / 90 days at the location scope: hotel bookings and nights, grooming appointments, daycare days, money collected (owner), collected-per-day chart, attention list (vaccine proofs, pending bookings, feedback), bookings by status.

spec.name: Revenue report
spec.purpose: Collected payments for the period by day, by service (hotel / grooming / daycare) and by method (card / cash), card fee and tax collected, outstanding balances, payment list, CSV export. Owner only.
logic: paid = payments.status paid && paid_at in period; service from invoices.source_type.
Fee and tax from invoices issued in the period; outstanding = sum(balance) of open invoices.
Blocked without reports.financial (EmptyState).
CSV built client-side.

spec.name: Occupancy report

layout: Per room type cards (meter + mini chart)
logic: occupied(day) = live bookings with check_in <= day < check_out.
capacity = sum capacities.max_simultaneous for the scoped locations by room_types.key.
